text.en: Customers consistently praise Al, Carla, Greg, and the boutique team for their warm guidance and thorough product knowledge. Reviewers mention that staff assist patrons in selecting appropriate treats and specialised nutrition for dogs with sensitivities. Visitors appreciate the attentive, unhurried customer service and the friendly presence of the house dog.

Shoppers highlight the charming, well-organised boutique layout featuring bakery cases filled with fresh biscuits and dog cakes. Reviewers appreciate the refrigerated section stocked with raw meals alongside premium kibble and durable pet accessories. Clients describe the shop as clean, welcoming, and enjoyable to browse with four-legged companions.

Dog owners report that freshly baked treats, bone bar selections, and hypoallergenic foods are enthusiastically received by their pets. Several reviewers note finding specialized food formulas that resolved persistent skin irritation and itching in allergic dogs. Picky eaters and sensitive pets are well catered for with natural, vetted ingredients.

q.en: Does Nauti Dog Barkery make custom dog birthday cakes?

a.en: Yes, reviewers mention ordering specialty dog cakes and celebration biscuits from the bakery.

q.en: Are raw dog food products available in the boutique?

a.en: Yes, the store carries refrigerated lines of raw meat products alongside natural treats and premium kibble.

q.en: Can pets visit the shop with their owners?

a.en: Yes, four-legged companions are warmly welcomed inside the boutique and can meet the shop dog.

q.en: Does the shop stock toys suitable for strong chewers?

a.en: Clients note that the durable toys and leads carried in store hold up significantly longer than standard pet chain items.
